source: Graph data are anchored to the latest full benchmark summaries in outputs/deep_method_comparison_5methods and expanded into deterministic CPU-friendly experiment series for research-style plotting.

units.task_completion_rate: completed tasks / target tasks, 0 to 1, higher is better
units.task_completion_time_ratio: deadline/time-success ratio, 0 to 1, higher is better
units.normalized_makespan_index: normalized makespan index, lower is better
units.energy_consumption_index: normalized energy-use index, lower is better
units.objective_index: normalized multi-objective cost, lower is better
units.collision_risk_index: normalized path-risk index, lower is better
units.min_battery_ratio: minimum remaining battery / 30% safety threshold, higher is better
units.recharge_need_index: normalized recharge/support demand, lower is better

recommended_figures: sensitivity_by_battery_stress.csv: battery and energy metrics vs battery_stress_index
